claims.assertion: Anéeka treats the unicorn as an ideal of unattainable perfection, using Swaruu's pursuit of total knowledge as an example.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Yazhi links unicorn symbolism to the third eye, pineal transformation, and veiled change; she frames Shiva/Pluto as positive and deceiving-Messiah/Antichrist imagery as negative.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi says souls lack gender, but embodied genders offer different experiences; souls may prefer one physical gender and choose another in a later incarnation.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
